title: SaaS analytics dashboard in Next.js
text: Client: saas company with a startup whose customers could not see their own usage data. Built a Next.js dashboard with server components, role-based access and charts over PostgreSQL. Result: cut support tickets about usage by 40%. Pages load in under one second at the 95th percentile.

title: Shopify store migration and custom theme
text: Client: ecommerce company with a clothing brand losing sales on a slow WooCommerce site. Migrated 1,200 products and orders to Shopify and built a custom Liquid theme. Result: raised mobile conversion rate from 1.1% to 1.9%. Redirects preserved existing search rankings.

title: Django REST API for a booking platform
text: Client: travel company with double bookings and slow availability checks. Designed a Django REST API with row-level locking and Celery tasks for confirmations. Result: eliminated double bookings and cut availability checks from 2 seconds to 150 milliseconds. The API is documented with OpenAPI.

title: Real-time chat with Node.js and WebSockets
text: Client: education company with an online tutoring platform without live chat. Built a Node.js and Socket.IO service with Redis pub/sub and a React chat widget. Result: handled 3,000 concurrent users in load tests. Messages are persisted in MongoDB with read receipts.

title: node-realtime: Real-time chat with Node.js and WebSockets

title: WordPress performance rescue
text: Client: media company with a news site timing out under traffic spikes. Profiled plugins, added object caching and moved assets behind Cloudflare. Result: improved Largest Contentful Paint from 4.8 seconds to 1.9 seconds. Core Web Vitals passed on mobile for the first time.

title: Stripe subscription billing integration
text: Client: saas company with a SaaS product billing customers manually by invoice. Integrated Stripe Checkout and subscriptions with idempotent webhook handling. Result: moved 300 customers to automatic billing without a failed charge going unnoticed. Failed payments trigger dunning emails.

title: React Native app for field inspections
text: Client: construction company with inspectors filling paper forms on site. Built an offline-first React Native app with photo capture and background sync. Result: cut report turnaround from three days to the same day. Works without signal and syncs when back online.

title: Test suite and CI for a legacy React app
text: Client: fintech company with frequent regressions in a legacy React front end. Added Jest unit tests, Playwright end-to-end tests and a GitHub Actions pipeline. Result: raised coverage from 12% to 68% and halved production incidents. Every pull request now runs the full suite.
